scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w packages/shared
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ruby && npm run lint:shell && npm run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:db && npm run test:unit
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
